name: media-rig-workspace
description: MediaRig component library and documentation workspace.

scripts.build:site: npm run build:registry && npm run build:site --workspace @media-rig/docs && node scripts/finalize-site-build.mjs

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace media-rig && npm run typecheck --workspace @media-rig/docs
